answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the wander queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The violet index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1352 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ledge. A 218 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
